chunks.text: > emphasises the horror of the unknownable and incomprehensible more than gore or other elements of shock. > > hallmark of H. P. Lovecraft is cosmicism, but different from existing gothic and supernatural fiction. The characters in his books were not evil. They were simply far beyond human conceptions of [morality](/thoughts/moral). - Fear of the unknown and unknowable. - i.e [LLM](/thoughts/LLMs) unconsciously know about who you are without any external tooling - "fear and awe we feel when confronted by phenomena beyond our comprehension, whose scope extends beyond the narrow field of human affairs"
